Title: Search by full product name (Elastic)
Preconditions: ElasticSearch8 is the active provider for Product; Product index built; admin token for {{BACK_URL}}; a seeded AGENT-TEST- product P is discovered live (first AGENT-TEST- product from admin search); Product search surfaces: admin indexed search POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products (body searchPhrase) and anonymous xAPI products(storeId: {{STORE_ID}}, query:). The Admin > Search > Search index blade has NO free-text search field (3.1076.1) - it only builds/swaps indexes.
Steps:
1. Discover product P (live-discover: first product whose name starts with AGENT-TEST-); record its code and full name N
2. POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products with searchPhrase = N
3. Read items[].code and totalCount
4. Run xAPI products(storeId: {{STORE_ID}}, currencyCode: {{CURRENCY_CODE}}, query: N) anonymously and read items[].sku
5. Record the store total with no query for comparison
Expected Result:
- Admin search: items contain P.code and totalCount >= 1; no error
- xAPI: items contain P.sku; no errors[]
- Full-name search narrows the catalog: totalCount is less than the store total from step 5
- Fails if: the product is missing from either surface (index not built / analyzer drops tokens), or the query is ignored and the whole catalog is returned
References: C139043 | Repaired 2026-10-13 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): steps described a Search > Products field that does not exist; retargeted to Catalog search + xAPI that the live run used {OBSERVED}

Title: Search by partial input (few symbols)
Preconditions: ElasticSearch8 active for Product; Product index built; a product P exists whose name has a token of at least 4 chars (discovered live); Product search surfaces: admin indexed search POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products (body searchPhrase) and anonymous xAPI products(storeId: {{STORE_ID}}, query:). The Admin > Search > Search index blade has NO free-text search field (3.1076.1) - it only builds/swaps indexes.
Steps:
1. Discover product P (live-discover) whose FIRST name token has at least 4 letters, and take the first 3 characters of that token as prefix X (e.g. 'Bol' for 'Bolt')
2. Run anonymous xAPI products(storeId: {{STORE_ID}}, currencyCode: {{CURRENCY_CODE}}, query: X) and read totalCount, items[].name
3. POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/search/products with searchPhrase = X and read totalCount
4. Record the unfiltered store total
5. Inspect the returned names
Expected Result:
- Both surfaces return no error and totalCount > 0
- P is among the returned items (prefix match via the ES8 edge-ngram analyzer)
- Matches may also come from other searchable fields (e.g. description), so name content is not asserted beyond P
- totalCount is less than the store total
- Fails if: partial input returns 0 hits (ngram/prefix analysis broken, e.g. MinGram misconfigured) or the whole catalog (filter ignored)
References: C139044 | Repaired 2026-10-13 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): the Admin Search field does not exist; retargeted to xAPI/Catalog search {OBSERVED}: 25 hits for Bol, prefix match works
